methodology.correctness: Blinded AI evaluations by Codex using manual-v1 criteria and pinned-source inspection; not human reviews. Scores were frozen before condition labels and aggregate results were examined. Exact duplicate question/answer/citation cases share one assessment; original output bindings are retained.
methodology.citation_validity: Mechanical presence of citation ID in retrieved evidence; semantic citation correctness is separately reviewed as citation_support.
methodology.observed_measurements: Include unsuccessful attempts; known-value means report accounting coverage and do not impute missing usage or cost.
methodology.failure_aware_correctness: All 202 completed outputs have AI scores. The 23 unsuccessful attempts with no answer text receive no review and contribute zero correctness. Each condition mean covers all 45 planned and observed attempts.
methodology.pairing: Question clusters averaged across all planned repetitions; exclude a question for a metric if any planned value on either side is unavailable.
methodology.uncertainty: Seeded paired question-cluster percentile bootstrap: 15 held-out questions, three repetitions, 2000 samples, seed 0, without multiplicity adjustment. Only the three comparisons fixed in paper/phase7-held-out-protocol.md are confirmatory, and their wording is in experiments/analysis/heldout-confirmatory-20261119/heldout-confirmatory.json; every other pair in this file is descriptive. Intervals do not establish inter-rater reliability, equivalence or non-inferiority, and cover one repository and one model.
methodology.scope: Per-query measurements exclude separately recorded indexing costs. Split/category counts describe observed records; restrict the frozen job set before aggregation when reporting a particular split or category.

budget_accounting.interpretation: Used-or-reserved admission estimates; not actual billed usage.

raw_load_issues: status.json: run status is 'completed_with_errors'; results are partial

review_provenance.authorization: Shekhar asked Codex for blind AI scoring of the 202 held-out answers under the frozen protocol on November 20, 2026, and asked Claude to run the comparisons after the freeze.
review_provenance.author_attestation_scope: Shekhar's statement that the scores were reviewed; no per-item human scores were supplied.
review_provenance.derivation: All CLI numeric results retained verbatim. Only three methodology descriptions are corrected for AI review, the failure denominator and the 15-question held-out design; explicit review provenance is added.
review_provenance.blinding: All scores and adjudications finalized without inspecting condition labels, selected strategies, raw traces, or any held-out aggregate, preflight, confirmatory analysis or run report. The sole raw access was the authorized binding-check script reading results.jsonl and displaying counts only. Graders received disjoint blinded cases and the unchanged criteria/pinned source; no prior review context. Answer styles may suggest a strategy.
review_provenance.limitations: One AI evaluation workflow with delegated source inspection and root adjudication; no per-item human review or inter-rater reliability estimate.
